references.sentence: To overcome the problems of the traditional cascode ampliﬁer, a new differential cascode ampliﬁer has been designed and is shown in Fig. 8.
In addition, the resistive divider is simple, accurate (with respect to temperature, process variation and cell current), fast, and its output can be Fig. 8.

Note that the differential ampliﬁer shown in Fig. 8 can be of any kind, such as one-stage, two-stage, current-mirror load, fully differential, etc. However, because the cascode ampliﬁer is a closed-loop feedback system, the number of stages is limited to one or two to have a good transient response.
An exactly the same cascode ampliﬁer shown in Fig. 8 is used for the reference cell.
